skill_name: Describe with vivid detail what a typical day in the life of a beekeeper looks like.
workflow: A beekeeper's day starts early, typically well before the sun rises. Once dressed in the protective veil and suit, the beekeeper heads out to the hive and begins his inspection for any signs of disease or infestation. Once satisfied, the beekeeper will move frames of honey and pollen around the beehive and collect what the bees have collected.
